sanskrit:
सुखं त्विदानीं त्रिविधं श‍ृणु मे भरतर्षभ ।
अभ्यासाद्रमते यत्र दुःखान्तं च निगच्छति ॥ १८-३६॥
iast:
sukhaṃ tvidānīṃ trividhaṃ śṛṇu me bharatarṣabha
abhyāsādramate yatra duḥkhāntaṃ ca nigacchati 18-36
translation: And now hear from me, O best among the Bharatas, of the three-fold pleasure in which one rejoices by practice, and surely comes to the end-of-pain.
